data: What is the approximate observed game score of the model represented by the green line at 500 Monte-Carlo rollouts?

The green line represents the full model's performance, and the red line represents the text-unaware latent-variable model's performance. The y-axis shows the observed game score, ranging from 0.2 to 1.6. At approximately 500 Monte-Carlo rollouts, the green line reaches an observed game score of around 1.4. Therefore, the approximate observed game score of the model represented by the green line at 500 Monte-Carlo rollouts is 1.4.
